name: arraySome
description: This function calls a given closure/function with every element in a given array and returns true, if one of the closure calls returns true.
syntax: arraySome( array array, function closure, [boolean parallel], [number maxThreads] )

params.name: closure
params.description: function/closure that implements the following constructor [function(any value[, numeric index,array array]):boolean].

params.name: maxThreads
params.description: maximum number of threads executed, ignored when argument "parallel" is set to false
